text: Remove the direct Laptop–Printer link. Leave the devices and the router links.
I think I've joined too much up. The laptop is meant to reach the printer through the router, so that line straight across between them shouldn't be there. Can you take just that line away?
the wire going straight from my computer to the printer delete that bit keep the boxes and the other wires please
There is one connection too many: the one bypassing Router. I'd like the drawing without it, with everything else kept.
Don't throw out my printer! I only want the line between it and Laptop gone. The two lines going up to Router are fine.
Orange sun.
The sun should be orange, please. I've already got yellow on the paper I'm printing this on.
Can the round yellow thing up there have the colour of an orange instead? It's my sun.
For the sun I ask the orange colour in place of yellow. The other parts have their right colours already.
okay um just change the sun from yellow to orange that's all I need before I print
Swap Ava and Omar's seats.
Omar needs to sit where Ava is now, and she can have his current place. Lin is staying put.
These two, Ava and Omar, have got each other's places on here. Could you exchange their boxes? I'm trying this seating arrangement on Monday.
ava goes to omars spot and omar to avas dont move lin
Please let Ava and Omar trade positions with one another. Their names are correct; it is the places which are exchanged.
Change the middle box's wording to Fold gently.
We were told not to stir muffin batter hard. Where you've written Stir, can you write Fold gently instead?
that middle instruction um replace the word stir with fold gently please
The recipe's nearly ready for the class. I just need the label on Stir replaced with 'Fold gently'. Then I can use it.
In the centre it should read Fold gently. Kindly remove the old writing Stir from that same box.
How many branches come straight off Weekend?
I'm losing track of my main ideas. Could you count just the ones joined directly to the middle circle, without counting ideas further down a branch?
does football count no hang on I only want to know how many things have their own line to weekend
Number of immediate neighbours of Weekend?
How many first branches has the weekend got? The football is a branch of games, so I do not include that one in my question.
Move CheckIn to the bottom left, keeping its layout.
Our welcome desk and its Start here sign belong down in the lower left corner. Please take them there together, with the sign still above the desk as it is now.
put the check in stuff bottom left dont jumble it up
The cake and book stalls can stay. It's the grouped desk and sign that need relocating to the bottom-left corner, preserving their positions relative to each other.
okay see the start here bit and the desk under it move that whole little set to the bottom left of the page just as it is
Add a one-way arrow from Cave to Tower.
You can get from the cave straight to the tower in my game. Can you show that route? The arrowhead goes at the tower because you can't use that route backwards.
cave -> tower please
There's a missing path out of Cave. It leads to Tower, with travel allowed only in that direction. Draw it in.
I want an arrow that starts at the grey cave and ends at the purple tower. Just the single direction, please.
Make Tired a diamond, keeping the text and connections.
Miss said the question needs the pointy shape, like a diamond. Can you do that to the Tired? box? It still needs to say Tired? and have all its arrows.
Everything is right except the shape around the question. Replace that rectangle with a diamond in the same place; keep what's written in it and the lines attached to it.
The tired question requires a diamond for its body. Please keep its writing and its roads as before.
um that box asking tired can it be a diamond instead same words same arrows
Copy Alien to its right.
He needs a twin! Make another one just like him on the right, eyes and everything. Keep this one too.
Could I have a second copy of the whole green face, placed to the right of the original? Same size and colours, please.
dont move him i want two of him the new one on the right
Please reproduce this complete alien at his right side. The first alien must remain where he stands.
Insert a Cool step between Bake and Ice, with the arrows going through it.
We forgot that the cake has to cool down. Can you put a box saying Cool after the baking and before the icing? The path should go through that box rather than straight from Bake to Ice.
bake then cool then ice. missing the cool box, fix the arrows too
If my son follows this he's going to put icing on a hot cake. Give him a Cool stage on the route from the oven to icing, replacing that direct arrow with the two links he needs.
After Bake please make Cool, and from Cool continue to Ice. The present road that jumps from Bake directly to Ice should no longer exist.
